'''''Ambush at Corellia''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Roger MacBride Allen]]. It is the first volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Corellian Trilogy]]'', and it was first published on [[February 2]], [[1995]] by [[Bantam Spectra]]. A sequel, ''[[Assault at Selonia]]'', was published later that year.
